compliance.status: compliant via RDP sites (AH-1 and AH-2 zones) plus prior-round credits and overlay zoning

notes: Washington Township: DCA Present Need = 0; Prospective Need = 184. Township accepted DCA obligations (resolution adopted prior to Jan 31, 2025). VLA reduces 4th Round RDP to 8 units (actually plan targets 21 affordable from two Pascack Road sites). Mediation Agreement with FSHC executed December 29, 2025 (post-plan adoption). Two 4th Round sites rezoned via Ordinance No. 26-02 (adopted March 2026): (1) AH-1 / Block 2329 Lot 2 = 370 Pascack Road: 72 townhouse units, min 15 affordable; (2) AH-2 / Block 2110 Lots 1, 6-11 = 660 Pascack Road: 32 townhouse units, min 7 affordable. Also existing overlay zones amended: Block 3405 Lot 1 (existing Affordable Housing Overlay, Stone Mills area, AA zone, updated to 3-4 affordable at 8 du/ac + 1 trust-funded unit); Block 3202.01 Lot 3 (O-R zone overlay, density increased to 18 du/ac). Note: HEFSP Table 4 shows 72 units/15 AH (370 Pascack) and 28 units/6 AH (660 Pascack) as originally planned; implementing ordinance (Ord. 26-02) finalizes 370 Pascack = 72/15 AH and 660 Pascack = 32/7 AH. Prior Round (1987-2025) compliance via: Franklin Ct / 283 Van Emburgh = Block 1102 Lots 1.04, 2, 11 (7 family rentals); VFW/639 Jefferson / Block 3103 Lot 25 (4 senior sales); Viviano Tract/463 Van Emburgh (payment in lieu $325k). Mandatory set-aside ordinance (20% for 5+ unit developments at 6+ du/ac) adopted. Unmet Need of ~176 units addressed through existing overlay zones plus mandatory set-aside.
